turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello! How's everything today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm good, thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're moving at the end of the month and I'm dreading the packing.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's a big job. Do you want to hire movers to pack for you, or do it yourselves and save the money?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: So my mum just texted and— look, this is important.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Moshi, pause, she's asking me something. I'll say when I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, I'll wait.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I stepped on your foot.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's fine, I've got thick socks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ethan, when does your passport expire? I need to check before I book anything.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Uh, sometime next year I think. Let me look.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Some countries want six months left on it, so it matters.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Okay, found it. It's good until next August.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Perfect, that works. Mine's fine too.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They've gone, so we're good. Carry on.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We were talking about the packing. Movers or do it yourselves?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, How on earth do I move a big tropical fish tank?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Carefully. Start by putting the fish in bags or buckets with water from their own tank.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How long can they stay in there?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A few hours is usually fine if they're kept warm and dark. Bring a battery air pump for longer trips.
